stat: 2019: 72 points, an MLS record at the time (broken by New England's 73 in 2021)
2019: +48 goal difference, an MLS record
2019: 85 goals in 34 games, tying the MLS record held by the 1998 Galaxy (who played 32)
Carlos Vela 2019: 34 league goals and 15 assists, the first 30-goal/15-assist season in MLS
Vela and Rossi 2019: 50 goals, the most by a duo in an MLS season
First club with three different MLS Golden Boot winners: Vela (2019), Rossi (2020), Bouanga (2023)
2022: Supporters' Shield and MLS Cup; the final finished 3-3 with Bale equalizing in the 128th minute, then LAFC won 3-0 on penalties
2024: U.S. Open Cup champions
Passed Vela as the club's all-time regular-season goals leader on Sept 19, 2026: 79 goals in 127 appearances vs Vela's 78 in 152
78 regular-season goals from 2023 through Sept 19, 2026, nine more than any other MLS player (Messi, 69)
First player in MLS history with 20+ goals in three straight seasons (2023-2025)
2025: 24 goals on 21.92 xG, per LAFC's playoff preview (about +2.1 over expected)
125 goals in all competitions for LAFC and 82 in the regular season as of Oct 14, 2026
Son Heung-min and Bouanga scored 17 consecutive LAFC regular-season goals in 2025, an MLS record for a duo
After Son joined in Aug 2025, the pair had 25 goals and 8 assists in 15 matches and LAFC went 9W-2L-4T
2026: 15 regular-season assists, tying Vela's club single-season record and tied for the MLS lead
2026: four assists in a half against Orlando (6-0, Apr 4), a club record; only the second MLS player to do so
2026: shutouts in the first six league games, an MLS record 540 minutes to open a season
12W-11L-11D, 47 points; the 52 goals are the fewest in any of LAFC's full seasons
Playoffs in 8 of 9 seasons (2018-2026); only 2021 (45 points) missed
11W-6L-2D in MLS Cup Playoff matches before 2026; 5W-1L-2D vs St. Louis all-time
